# Recto: Shikaku Patches Puzzle

> Recto (also listed as "Shikaku Patches Puzzle - Recto", and known as "Patches") is a free, calm, candy-bright mobile puzzle game for iOS and Android based on Shikaku, the classic Japanese "rectangle division" logic puzzle popularized by Nikoli. Players draw rectangles on a grid so that every rectangle contains exactly one number and covers exactly that many cells; covering the whole grid solves the puzzle.

## Key facts

- Name: Recto (App Store listing: "Shikaku Patches Puzzle - Recto"; subtitle: "Daily rectangle brain teasers")
- Genre: Shikaku / rectangle-division logic puzzle (related to Sudoku, Nonogram/Picross, Kakuro)
- Price: free to download and play
- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Levels: 1,100+ handcrafted puzzles across 5 difficulty tracks (Baby, Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), from 4×4 up to 18×18 grids
- Works fully offline; no account needed
- Cloud save: Game Center on iOS, Google Play Games on Android
- Smart hint system, undo, solve timer, score, daily missions, streaks and token rewards
- Localized into 46 in-app languages; store listings in ~50 locales
- Developer: Furkan Akif İşlek

## How to play Shikaku

1. Read the numbers: each clue gives the exact area of the rectangle that must contain it.
2. Draw rectangles: drag to draw a patch; every patch must hold exactly one number and cover exactly that many cells.
3. Fill the board: when every cell belongs to a patch, the puzzle is solved.
